title: The Big Harvest
story: The whole 8x8 field needs tending. Write a function that plants, waters, and harvests one tile, then call it for every non-rock tile.
hint: Write a function tend(x, y) that calls goTo, plant, water, and harvest. Then call it inside two nested loops.
